Deepest node the three Sardinians (I14677, I14678, I15942) reach: their own SNP-positive fields stop here and they are ancestral at L166 on 21 reads. FTDNA G-PF3239 block walk resolved 22 of 24 names derived in the Iceman.

Splits the YFull L166 block upward. 25 derived reads at Z6219 and zero ancestral across Oberbipp (10) plus Aesch and Muttenz (15), in the same men who are ancestral at L166 on 59 reads (14 Oberbipp, 45 Aesch/Muttenz) with zero derived; Iceman and I5118 derived at both Z6219 and L166. FGC5671 co-segregates (Iceman 7/0, Sardinians ancestral). Z6219 is C>T, so the derived direction is damage-exposed and was cleared per-read; the ancestral L166/L167 calls are transversions and cannot be damage. Registered in PREREG_Z6219_node.md, confirmed by Test C at a second and third site. The Z6135/Z6209 equivalents are a post-hoc scan result, unregistered, and carry no weight.

Terminal placement of the Iceman. He and I5118 (Hungary, 3300-3000 BCE) are derived at both transversions; Oberbipp, Aesch and Muttenz are ancestral at both. The node itself is published and uncontested -- what is new is its parent and its children. Equivalents are YFull block members no sample here orders against L166: Z6134 is bracketed (ancestral in Aesch, derived in the Iceman) so it arose somewhere between Z6219 and L166, and the rest are untested or uncovered. L166, L167, Z6208 and Z1370 are allele-biased for mappability, so derived counts at them are lower bounds.

The published Iceman label G2a2a1a2a1a1b (G-Z6208*) treats Z6208 as a node below L166. It is not one: YBrowse/YFull give yfull_node=G-L166, ISOGG's own longhand carries the provisional tilde (G2a2a1a2a1a1b~), and no ancient sample orders it -- zero reads across all 15 Oberbipp and all 15 Aesch/Muttenz libraries. The Iceman is derived at Z6208 (DP 9) and that is all the marker says; a derived SNP was read as a terminal placement, one node too deep.
Sibling branch below L166. The Iceman is ancestral at all three (Z6494 DP 10), so his line is not on it. Kept as the exclusion control; see markers/Z6494_exclusion.txt.

One node further down the sibling branch (yfull_node=G-Z6211 for all three in resources/marker_index.tsv.gz). The Iceman is ancestral at all three, which follows from his being ancestral at G-Z6494 and adds nothing; it is here so those markers resolve rather than being reported as unknown.

Splits the L166 block downward, onto the branch leading to the modern testers the block was built from. Iceman ancestral 10 of 10 at a C>T site, so an ancestral C cannot be deamination; NM=0 on every read, MAPQ 55-60, 0% MQ0, mappability 1.000 at both alleles at 60 and 100 bp with six of the ten reads in that stratum. MX213 and I14677 contribute 1 ancestral read each. Below-versus-parallel rests on parsimony alone: no sample derived at Z6499 and ancestral at L166 has been sought, and its relation to G-Z6494 is unresolved.
